notes: LED video processor (converts SDI/HDMI source signals into LED-panel pixel data over 10G links); no category in the provided list matches precisely, so "converter" was used as closest fit. Rear panel has 4 identical "Tessera 10G Output" groups (silkscreened A-D), each comprising one etherCON/RJ45 10GBASE-T copper port and one opticalCON (LC-Duplex-compatible) 10GBASE-LR fibre port; within each group only one of the two (fibre or copper) is active at a time (auto-switching), both are listed as physical ports. DMX In/Thru are 5-pin XLR (In=male, Thru=female). Rear silkscreen shows both "HDMI IN" and "HDMI THRU" jacks; full spec text details only the single HDMI 2.0b input, so HDMI Thru is treated as a passthrough of that input (analogous to the explicitly documented "re-clocked" SDI Thru). Ref In/Thru are BNC bi-level/tri-level analog sync (ungraded - not an SDI data signal). The rear "Local UI" DisplayPort (DP++) is a local-monitor output, not part of the video processing signal path. Two USB 3.0 ports are on the rear (Local UI); two USB 2.0 Type-A ports are on the front panel.
